destination.title: Species, gravitational cutoffs and towers
destination.question: How do particle species and towers constrain gravitational validity scales, black-hole behavior and attainable entropy?
destination.summary: Connects cutoff arguments, bounded thermal systems and proposed species thermodynamics while retaining their different mechanisms and limits.

assumptions: Noncollapse and equilibrium conditions apply only where stated
conventions: Particle species N is distinct from occupation number and algebraic large N
excludes: A universal cutoff formula independent of dimension or conventions

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture for the Effective Field Theories with N Species

evidence.text: Can an N-species relativistic gas be heated above the species gravity scale while remaining a bounded, noncollapsed thermodynamic system?

sources.title: Nature of Microscopic Black Holes and Gravity in Theories with Particle Species

evidence.text: What properties of microscopic black holes and short-distance gravity follow from unitarity and consistency with macroscopic black-hole physics in theories with N particle species, without specifying microscopic gravity or assuming extra dimensions?

sources.title: A Bound on the effective gravitational coupling from semiclassical black holes

evidence.text: Can a consistent classical modification of Einstein gravity permit semiclassical black holes smaller than the species scale, or does semiclassical black-hole existence impose a universal upper bound on the effective gravitational coupling above the ultraviolet cutoff?

sources.title: Black Hole Quantum Mechanics in the Presence of Species

evidence.text: Does the black-hole species bound survive finite-occupation-number quantum hair, and how does the nature of species affect the lightest black holes and the possibility of gravitational self-UV-completion?

sources.title: A Note on the Swampland Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: What can a simple many-species thermal system say about entropy constraints when the actual light-tower entropy is inaccessible? The surrogate is a noncollapsing relativistic gas in a sphere, with gravitational interactions otherwise neglected.

sources.title: On the origin of species thermodynamics and the black hole - tower correspondence

evidence.text: Can ordinary thermodynamics explain the species constitutive relations and area scaling, constrain admissible towers, and parametrically account for Schwarzschild black-hole entropy through a black hole–tower correspondence?

sources.title: The Shortest scale of quantum field theory

evidence.text: Can QFT with many species, a Minkowski vacuum and gravitating vacuum fluctuations remain consistent up to Planckian momenta? Does a species-dependent ultraviolet cutoff help reconcile QFT with black-hole entropy constraints?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture for the Effective Field Theories with N Species

evidence.text: Divide S < EL by E and insert the relativistic gas ratio S/E. This produces the lower size bound needed to test compatibility with the independently derived collapse upper bound.

sources.title: Nature of Microscopic Black Holes and Gravity in Theories with Particle Species

evidence.text: Parameterizes species-dependent gravity by V(r)∼Mi mj/[M*²rνij(r)], estimates horizons from order-one Newtonian potential, and introduces capture probabilities Pij. The proposed evaporation law sums −(rgij)^−2Pij over thermally available species.

sources.title: A Bound on the effective gravitational coupling from semiclassical black holes

evidence.text: Combine slow evaporation and metastability conditions with the black-body emission law and wavelength bound. The authors obtain M R_S>N(β) and an additional inequality containing d ln R_S/d ln M, then argue that the latter supplies no independent restriction.

sources.title: Black Hole Quantum Mechanics in the Presence of Species

evidence.text: An operational pixel thought experiment localises one representative of every species, estimates the required energy and induced graviton occupation, and compares black-hole hair-extraction time with the intended resolution time.

sources.title: A Note on the Swampland Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Normalize two object constraints to the same variable, compare their endpoints, and substitute model-specific scaling laws afterward. Here the black-hole mass is eliminated first, separating the species consistency bound from the assumed exponential field dependence.

sources.title: On the origin of species thermodynamics and the black hole - tower correspondence

evidence.text: Microcanonical counting uses coefficients of a generating function for mass partitions, extracted by contour integration. Entropy is extremized with respect to species number through a species chemical potential; this counting explicitly restricts masses to the cutoff.

sources.title: Bounds on Black Hole Entropy in Unitary Theories of Gravity

evidence.text: In weakly coupled unitary extensions of Einstein gravity, does semiclassical black-hole entropy exceed the number of light species, and is Einstein entropy minimal at fixed mass? The paper also investigates analogous AdS black-brane entropy-density statements.

sources.title: Can gravitational-wave data shed light on dark matter particles?

evidence.text: Can imposing an additional sign-based consistency criterion on logarithmic black-hole entropy corrections translate historical gravitational-wave area-theorem results into restrictions on matter species, including axion dark-matter candidates?

sources.title: Black hole entropy as entanglement entropy: A Holographic derivation

evidence.text: Can black hole entropy be identified entirely with quantum-field entanglement across the horizon while accounting for ultraviolet dependence, the species problem, and gravitational backreaction?

sources.title: Entropy bounds and black hole remnants

evidence.text: Does accounting for Unruh–Wald buoyancy preserve a GSL-based entropy bound, and can species proliferation, additional spatial dimensions, or information-storing black hole remnants evade it?

sources.title: Effective field theory, large number of particle species, and holography

evidence.text: How does adding many particle species to an effective QFT with holographic UV/IR mixing change the entropy of near-collapse systems, constrain the species count and permit entanglement entropy to match black-hole entropy?

sources.title: Gravitational wave constraints on corrections to Bekenstein-Hawking Area Formula in classical F(R) gravity and quantum GR : implications for theory parameters

evidence.text: Can gravitational-wave analyses supporting the Hawking Area Theorem constrain small additive corrections to black-hole entropy, and thereby F(R) parameters or quantum-field species, when combined with the generalized second law and an additional sign criterion?

sources.title: Black hole entropy and induced gravity

evidence.text: What information accounts for black hole entropy, and can the same quantum fluctuations explain both horizon entanglement and the gravitational coupling appearing in A/(4ħG), including its dependence on matter species?

sources.title: Black Hole Bound on the Number of Species and Quantum Gravity at LHC

evidence.text: How does a large number of particle species constrain their mass scale and the gravitational cutoff, and could those constraints explain the weak/Planck hierarchy and require unusual microscopic black-hole decay patterns?

sources.title: Entropy bounds and the species scale distance conjecture

evidence.text: Can the Covariant Entropy Bound explain the geodesic and exponential features of the Swampland Distance Conjecture, constrain species-scale decay rates, and yield a condition preserved under dimensional reduction?

sources.title: Black Hole Entropy and Gravity Cutoff

evidence.text: Can black-hole entanglement entropy reproduce the universal Bekenstein–Hawking area law despite its apparent dependence on the number of particle species, once the gravitational cutoff depends on that number?

sources.title: IR/UV mixing, towers of species and swampland conjectures

evidence.text: What entropy can an EFT assign to a finite region before gravitational restrictions invalidate its extensive state count? The baseline comparison uses the original fields and leaves tower entropy out.

sources.title: Infinite Black Hole Entropies at Infinite Distances and Tower of States

evidence.text: Which degrees of freedom become light when a black hole horizon and its entropy grow without bound? The investigation relates a distance between background metrics to internal compactification modes and to excitations connecting black hole microstates.

sources.title: Quantum Information and Gravity Cutoff in Theories with Species

evidence.text: Can limitations on species information storage, detection and quantum cloning independently motivate the species-dependent gravity cutoff, and can matching black-hole validity thresholds illuminate field-theory/gravity correspondence?

sources.title: A proof of the Bekenstein bound for any strength of gravity through holography

evidence.text: Can the GCEB-motivated minimum thermodynamic length imply the Bekenstein entropy bound at arbitrary gravitational strength, when energy and radius are unambiguous, and constrain viscosity and species proliferation?

sources.title: Species entropy and thermodynamics

evidence.text: Can particle species and their gravitational cutoff admit thermodynamic quantities analogous to minimal black holes, providing an entropic interpretation of swampland constraints?

sources.title: Emergence of species scale black hole horizons

evidence.text: Can integrating out the light tower associated with a small black hole's infinite-distance core connect three meanings of the species scale: the species-counting cutoff, the onset of higher-derivative corrections, and the inverse radius of the smallest EFT-describable black hole?

sources.title: Black Shells, Dirac's Field and the species problem

evidence.text: Can a collapsing thin-shell description supply a physical near-horizon cutoff, reproduce Bekenstein–Hawking entropy from a Dirac thermal atmosphere, and remove the species dependence when scalar and spinor contributions are combined?

sources.title: Quantum Gravity in Species Regime

evidence.text: Can a large number of particle species isolate collective and nonperturbative quantum-gravity effects while suppressing other corrections, and clarify black-hole/de Sitter depletion, entanglement and quantum breaking?

sources.title: Species and Strings

evidence.text: Can semiclassical black-hole evaporation and gravitational limits on species resolution explain effective string-species counting, black-hole entropy bounds, and their continuation into the strong-coupling M-theory limit?

sources.title: Why the entropy of spacetime is independent of species of particles -- the species problem

evidence.text: How can Bekenstein–Hawking entropy remain independent of the number of radiated particle species if all those species contribute to a black-hole atmosphere? The authors offer a proposed resolution by identifying spacetime entropy with atmosphere entropy.

sources.title: Distance and de Sitter Conjectures on the Swampland

evidence.text: How can an entropy-compatible tower produce a dark-sector mass spacing? The source assumes evenly spaced levels and a cutoff between N^−1/2 and the Planck scale, then illustrates the scaling at R∼10^60.

sources.title: A short overview on the Black Hole-Tower Correspondence and Species Thermodynamics

evidence.text: Can black-hole entropy be related to the microscopic entropy of weakly coupled towers at the species cutoff, and can thermodynamic consistency constrain the allowed towers? This proceedings review summarizes the proposed Black Hole–Tower correspondence and Species Thermodynamics.

sources.title: Generalized gravitational entropy

evidence.text: Can Euclidean gravitational entropy be defined without a circle-translation Killing symmetry, and can a gravitational replica construction explain why the entropy is given by a codimension-two minimal-surface area?

sources.title: Why the entropy of spacetime is independent of species of particles -- the species problem

evidence.text: How can Bekenstein–Hawking entropy remain independent of the number of radiated particle species if all those species contribute to a black-hole atmosphere? The authors offer a proposed resolution by identifying spacetime entropy with atmosphere entropy.

sources.title: Black Shells, Dirac's Field and the species problem

evidence.text: Can a collapsing thin-shell description supply a physical near-horizon cutoff, reproduce Bekenstein–Hawking entropy from a Dirac thermal atmosphere, and remove the species dependence when scalar and spinor contributions are combined?

sources.title: Gravity and the crossed product

evidence.text: How do perturbative gravitational corrections change the emergent large-N algebra outside an eternal black hole, and permit a definition of black hole entropy?

sources.title: Black hole entropy is the Noether charge

evidence.text: In general Lagrangian gravity, can the first-law horizon term be written as κ/(2π) times the variation of a local geometrical entropy, and how does that entropy relate to Noether charge, dynamical horizons and Euclidean methods?

sources.title: Black hole entropy and induced gravity

evidence.text: What information accounts for black hole entropy, and can the same quantum fluctuations explain both horizon entanglement and the gravitational coupling appearing in A/(4ħG), including its dependence on matter species?

sources.title: Quantum de Sitter horizon entropy from quasicanonical bulk, edge, sphere and topological string partition functions

evidence.text: How can exact quantum corrections to de Sitter horizon entropy be computed for general gravitational EFT spectra, organized into bulk and edge contributions, and used to constrain proposed microscopic entropies?

sources.title: Logarithmic corrections, entanglement entropy, and UV cutoffs in de Sitter spacetime

evidence.text: Can a conformal description of the cosmological horizon explain de Sitter entanglement entropy, its logarithmic corrections and UV regulator, and the proposed finite dimension of an observer's Hilbert space?

sources.title: A string theoretic derivation of gibbons-hawking entropy

evidence.text: Can open-string Chan–Paton species provide a microscopic account of Gibbons–Hawking entropy for a temporary de Sitter-like state, and explain its area scaling without constructing an eternal de Sitter vacuum?

sources.title: Generalized gravitational entropy

evidence.text: Add and subtract an off-shell rounded-cone configuration. At first order in n−1, the equations of motion cancel the bulk variation with fixed outer boundary data; the remaining localized curvature contribution gives the area term. An equivalent calculation uses the inner boundary variation.

sources.title: Why the entropy of spacetime is independent of species of particles -- the species problem

evidence.text: Use the scalar radial Klein–Gordon equation in the tortoise coordinate r* = r + r0 ln(r/r0−1). In the limit r → r0, the displayed equation reduces to a massless wave equation. This example motivates treating near-horizon species as ultrarelativistic.

sources.title: Black Shells, Dirac's Field and the species problem

evidence.text: The shell treatment reviews induced metrics, extrinsic curvature and Darmois–Israel junction conditions. Surface stress is related to the jump in extrinsic curvature, yielding a radial equation involving gravitational mass M and rest mass μ.

sources.title: Quantum de Sitter horizon entropy from quasicanonical bulk, edge, sphere and topological string partition functions

evidence.text: Harish–Chandra characters encode global single-particle representations. Their regulated Fourier transforms define static-patch spectral densities; character integrals compute quasicanonical thermodynamics and sphere determinants. Tools include covariant Pauli–Villars/heat-kernel regularization, Hubbard–Stratonovich transformation, contour deformation, Hurwitz zeta functions and residue sums.

sources.title: Gravity and the crossed product

evidence.text: Use Π=−i∂/∂U and order-by-order conjugations to remove ambiguities in identifying H′_R/N with U+ĥ/(βN). Correspondingly conjugate the left algebra so that the left and right algebras commute.

sources.title: Logarithmic corrections, entanglement entropy, and UV cutoffs in de Sitter spacetime

evidence.text: Euclidean replica partition functions relate modular free energy to Rényi entropy. The calculation imports Cardy state counting and Carlip's Gaussian correction; a separate large-q treatment uses an inherited classical Liouville truncation onto the defects.

sources.title: Black holes and entropy

evidence.text: How can black-hole area acquire the meaning and dimensions of entropy, and how should the second law account for ordinary entropy disappearing behind a horizon?

sources.title: The Volume of black holes

evidence.text: Can stationary spacetimes admit a thermodynamically meaningful volume independent of stationary slicing, and can discrete identifications produce bounded horizon area with unbounded volume? The latter question motivates a conditional discussion of the statistical interpretation of black-hole entropy.

sources.title: Partition Function for a Volume of Space

evidence.text: Can a gravitational partition function count states of a topological ball at fixed proper spatial volume, and does its leading saddle yield boundary-area entropy for zero, positive or negative cosmological constant?

sources.title: Black hole entropy as entanglement entropy: A Holographic derivation

evidence.text: Can black hole entropy be identified entirely with quantum-field entanglement across the horizon while accounting for ultraviolet dependence, the species problem, and gravitational backreaction?

sources.title: The entropy of Hawking radiation

evidence.text: How can gravitational fine-grained entropy methods compute Hawking-radiation entropy consistently with unitary evaporation, despite the growing entropy obtained from the semiclassical radiation state?

sources.title: Effective field theory, large number of particle species, and holography

evidence.text: How does adding many particle species to an effective QFT with holographic UV/IR mixing change the entropy of near-collapse systems, constrain the species count and permit entanglement entropy to match black-hole entropy?

sources.title: Black Hole's Quantum N-Portrait

evidence.text: Can black-hole classicality, Hawking radiation, entropy and proposed gravitational UV self-completion be described through the graviton occupation number N, with geometric quantities emerging at large N?

sources.title: Black Hole Entropy and Gravity Cutoff

evidence.text: Can black-hole entanglement entropy reproduce the universal Bekenstein–Hawking area law despite its apparent dependence on the number of particle species, once the gravitational cutoff depends on that number?

sources.title: Thermodynamic split conjecture and an observational test for cosmological entropy

evidence.text: Do controlled string-theoretic black-hole entropy constructions justify the same observer-independent microstate interpretation for cosmological horizons, and can tomographic information proxies test a proposed cosmological area scaling?

sources.title: Microscopic Origin of Page Curve

evidence.text: Which degrees of freedom within a gravitational theory account for black-hole Wald entropy and the entanglement underlying the Page curve? The paper seeks to identify their Hamiltonian phase-space origin rather than add unspecified microstates to the theory.

sources.title: Black Hole Quantum Mechanics in the Presence of Species

evidence.text: Does the black-hole species bound survive finite-occupation-number quantum hair, and how does the nature of species affect the lightest black holes and the possibility of gravitational self-UV-completion?

sources.title: From entropy to echoes: Counting the quasi-normal modes and the quantum limit of silence

evidence.text: Can thermally weighted quasi-normal-mode counting account for black-hole entropy, and can near-horizon dissipation connect an area-law entropy to gravitational-wave echo times?

sources.title: Area Law Saturation of Entropy Bound from Perturbative Unitarity in Renormalizable Theories

evidence.text: Does saturation of information-storage bounds acquire an area-law form in nongravitational renormalizable field theories, and is this tied to the boundary of perturbative unitarity?

sources.title: Entropy and spectrum of near-extremal black holes: semiclassical brane solutions to non-perturbative problems

evidence.text: Why does gravitational entropy become negative near extremality, and can semiclassical gravity compute a thermodynamically meaningful quenched entropy when the topological expansion fails?

sources.title: Infinite Black Hole Entropies at Infinite Distances and Tower of States

evidence.text: Horizon area provides a macroscopic entropy against which geometric distances and microscopic excitation scales can be compared. The number of black hole microstates grows exponentially with this entropy.

sources.title: On the origin of species thermodynamics and the black hole - tower correspondence

evidence.text: Can ordinary thermodynamics explain the species constitutive relations and area scaling, constrain admissible towers, and parametrically account for Schwarzschild black-hole entropy through a black hole–tower correspondence?

sources.title: Black hole entropy from near horizon microstates

evidence.text: Can black-hole entropy be obtained by counting excitations of a locally AdS3 near-horizon region, using general gravitational symmetry and conformal-state asymptotics without requiring string theory or supersymmetry?

sources.title: Quantum Gravity in Species Regime

evidence.text: Can a large number of particle species isolate collective and nonperturbative quantum-gravity effects while suppressing other corrections, and clarify black-hole/de Sitter depletion, entanglement and quantum breaking?

sources.title: Black Hole as a Quantum Field Configuration

evidence.text: Can semiclassical gravity and quantum matter provide a self-consistent evaporating black-hole interior, explain its supporting pressure and energy loss, and reproduce the entropy area law by counting field configurations?

sources.title: Large N algebras and generalized entropy

evidence.text: Can generalized black-hole entropy emerge as the statistical entropy of an explicit large N operator algebra using Lorentzian physics, and can algebra inclusions explain a controlled case of the generalized second law?

sources.title: Entanglement and local holography in quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can string theory supply a gravitational Hilbert-space factorization and bulk entanglement entropy that reproduces extremal-surface areas at low energy, despite gravitational constraints and the absence of diffeomorphism-invariant spatial subregions?

sources.title: The Holographic principle

evidence.text: What general relation between surface area and information survives the failure of spatial entropy bounds, and does that relation reveal fundamental degrees of freedom of quantum gravity?

sources.title: Black holes and entropy

evidence.text: Does adding an area-dependent black-hole entropy preserve a second-law inequality when ordinary entropy disappears through the horizon?

sources.title: Dimensional reduction in quantum gravity

evidence.text: What restrictions do unitary black hole physics and entropy counting place on microscopic quantum-gravity degrees of freedom, and can local discrete models realize the resulting surface encoding while retaining nontrivial dynamics and the required symmetries?

sources.title: Black hole from entropy maximization

evidence.text: Can maximizing thermodynamic entropy at fixed boundary area characterize a quantum black hole and determine a self-consistent interior without assuming either a horizon or the Bekenstein-Hawking formula?

sources.title: On black hole thermodynamics, singularity, and gravitational entropy

evidence.text: How are black-hole thermodynamics and microstructure connected to singularities, cosmic censorship and curvature-based gravitational entropy? Can Hookean and Ruppeiner descriptions illuminate differences between black holes in different gravitational theories?

sources.title: A short overview on the Black Hole-Tower Correspondence and Species Thermodynamics

evidence.text: Can black-hole entropy be related to the microscopic entropy of weakly coupled towers at the species cutoff, and can thermodynamic consistency constrain the allowed towers? This proceedings review summarizes the proposed Black Hole–Tower correspondence and Species Thermodynamics.

destinations.title: Can Euclidean gravitational entropy be defined without a circle-translation Killing symmetry, and can a gravitational replica construction explain why the entropy is given by a codimension-two minimal-surface area?

How can Bekenstein–Hawking entropy remain independent of the number of radiated particle species if all those species contribute to a black-hole atmosphere? The authors offer a proposed resolution by identifying spacetime entropy with atmosphere entropy.

Can a collapsing thin-shell description supply a physical near-horizon cutoff, reproduce Bekenstein–Hawking entropy from a Dirac thermal atmosphere, and remove the species dependence when scalar and spinor contributions are combined?
How do perturbative gravitational corrections change the emergent large-N algebra outside an eternal black hole, and permit a definition of black hole entropy?

In general Lagrangian gravity, can the first-law horizon term be written as κ/(2π) times the variation of a local geometrical entropy, and how does that entropy relate to Noether charge, dynamical horizons and Euclidean methods?

What information accounts for black hole entropy, and can the same quantum fluctuations explain both horizon entanglement and the gravitational coupling appearing in A/(4ħG), including its dependence on matter species?
